hooks.command:
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')
[ -z "$f" ] && exit 0
map=".claude/docs-map.json"
[ -f "$map" ] || exit 0
matches="[]"
while IFS= read -r entry; do
  title=$(jq -r '.title' <<<"$entry")
  doc=$(jq -r '.doc' <<<"$entry")
  hit=0
  while IFS= read -r pattern; do
    case "$f" in $pattern) hit=1 ;; esac
  done < <(jq -r '.paths[]' <<<"$entry")
  if [ "$hit" = 1 ]; then
    matches=$(jq -c --arg t "$title" --arg d "$doc" '. + [{title:$t, doc:$d}]' <<<"$matches")
  fi
done < <(jq -c '.[]' "$map")
[ "$matches" = "[]" ] && exit 0
jq -n --argjson m "$matches" '
  ("Docs that may now be outdated: " + ([$m[] | (.title + " (" + .doc + ")")] | join("; ")) + ". Use the documentation skill to review/update.") as $msg
  | {systemMessage: $msg, hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: $msg}}'
